beats.headline: Sponsor to a goddess
beats.text: Subject is of the Grixist Swarm, an heiress and chief executive of Icon Industries, and at present the sponsor driving the goddess Eileithyia. She sponsored Dodola every season before this one. The sums involved are a day’s allowance to her. She does not do it for the money. She does it because she is bored.

beats.headline: What she did to Armita
beats.text: Per the account Odette gives Carl off the record: subject was driving the goddess Dodola when Odette broke their illegal arrangement at the last minute, and Dodola was trapped in a containment and slain by Chaco before the Ascendency game began. Odette's friend Armita, who had facilitated the deal, was still inside for a few more seasons. The first thing subject did on returning the following season was kill her. Perfectly legal, in the dungeon. Subject received a token punishment and a permanent ban from Dodola. Odette calls her the most evil person she knows.

beats.headline: A plain bolt between the eyes
beats.text: Huanxin Jinx of the Grixist Swarm, CEO of Icon Industries, arrived wearing her goddess to collect Katia and was loudly unpleasant about the delay. Crawler Princess Donut laundered her out of the soul armour and onto a circle she could not teleport from. Her shields lasted one pass of Claw. The bolt that killed her was plain and unenchanted, with some of Mordecai's mother's ashes in the tip, fired from Katia's crossbow on the cat's back. She came to rest at Victory's feet.
